items.period: Shang oracle-script style; the file is a modern digital depiction based on a cited J20963 image
items.caption: Modern redraw of a form proposed as an early graph for 視.裘錫圭 distinguishes this standing-figure form from a kneeling-figure form read as 見; the identification is a scholarly interpretation.
items.alt: Black oracle-script-style vector showing an eye-like form above a standing human figure.
items.selection_reason: The candidate illustrates the proposed early pictographic form relevant to the graphic history. The source identifies it as a digitally created depiction, not an artifact photograph or scan.
items.rights: Public-domain release stated on the Wikimedia Commons file page.

limitations.text: The graph reading is debated: the inspected paleographic article reports and rejects an earlier interpretation as 望. The illustration is a modern redraw, and the direct upload fetch failed, so its pixels were not inspected in this stage.
